name: Planar Half-Orc
body:
Note Generally more powerful than their Material Plane counterparts, this humanoid variant are more likely be encountered as NPCs but may occasionally be allowed as player characters for high-powered campaigns.

Planar half-orcs are rare and even more outcast than usual. They are incredibly resilient—and they need to be.

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +4 Wis, +2 Str, +2 Dex, +2 Con, –2 Cha. This trait alters ability scores.
Languages You begin play speaking Common and Orc. If you have a high Intelligence score, you can choose from any language except for secret languages. This trait alters languages.
Planar Adaptation You gain resistance 5 to acid and fire. This trait replaces orc ferocity.

Awesome Ancestries: Variant Species Options, Vol. 2 – Mortals of the Multiverse. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum
